contributor_eligibility.category_A_native_telugu: Fluent native or heritage Telugu speaker capable of writing natural Telugu-script sentences.
contributor_eligibility.category_B_english_telugu: Conversational bilingual speaker comfortable using English and Telugu within the same utterance.
contributor_eligibility.category_C_hindi_telugu: Bilingual speaker proficient in written Hindi (Devanagari) and Telugu (Telugu script).
contributor_eligibility.category_D_english_hindi_telugu: Trilingual speaker proficient in English, Hindi, and Telugu across all three scripts (Latin, Devanagari, Telugu).
contributor_eligibility.screening_method: Non-intrusive self-reported proficiency questionnaire without collecting sensitive dossiers.
contributor_eligibility.pii_exclusion: No legal names, phone numbers, email addresses, student roll numbers, or government IDs stored in dataset records.
contributor_eligibility.minor_protection: Adult participants (>=18 years) required for initial pilot. Formal IRB approval and parental consent required before any minor participation.

draft_consent_summary.project_purpose: Academic NLP research on token-level language identification in mixed Indian languages.
draft_consent_summary.voluntary_nature: Participation is entirely voluntary; refusal or withdrawal carries no academic or personal penalty.
draft_consent_summary.withdrawal_right: Contributors may withdraw submissions at any time prior to the designated Dataset Freeze Date.
draft_consent_summary.anonymity: Contributors identified exclusively by pseudonyms (contrib_XX); zero PII collected.
draft_consent_summary.proposed_license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) for research and open publication.
draft_consent_summary.non_commercial_scope: Operating within an academic setting does not automatically establish non-commercial status under CC terms; institutional review required prior to external distribution.
draft_consent_summary.legal_notice: Clearly designated as a draft for faculty and institutional ethics review, not a finalized legal contract.

elicitation_strategy.pilot_target: 40 total sentences (10 per category across 3 independent adult contributors).
elicitation_strategy.scenario_design: Situational prompts outlining context and communicative intent without providing example sentences (prevents template copying).
elicitation_strategy.lexical_threshold: At least one unambiguous lexical token from every participating language required by the category.
elicitation_strategy.synthetic_text_rule: LLM generation alone is strictly prohibited from ground-truth data. Parallel text is never automatically concatenated.

reviewer_process.stage_1_screening: Fluent reviewer verifies sentence naturalness, script conformity, tokenization, and initial labels.
reviewer_process.stage_2_independent_audit: Independent second linguist conducts blind token audit, checks NE (-100) and MIXED (-100) governance, independently recalculates language statistics, and adjudicates consensus.

acceptance_rate_methodology.category_stratification: Calculated independently for Native_Telugu, English_Telugu, Hindi_Telugu, and English_Hindi_Telugu.
acceptance_rate_methodology.projections_policy: No invented expected acceptance rates; empirical pilot results dictate full dataset drafting quotas.
acceptance_rate_methodology.isolation_rule: Pilot records are quarantined in pilot/ and are NOT automatically added to reviewed_sentences.jsonl or final splits.

bht25_source_group_decision.investigation_status: BHT25 public Parquet files provide only id, bn, hi, te. Work and book identifiers are absent in raw rows, leaving document grouping unresolved.

comparison.route_A_manual_literary_mapping: Extract Category A from BHT25 and manually align rows against original Tagore/Chattopadhyay novels to assign source_group_id. High labor, high risk of boundary errors, and carries archaic 19th-century literary domain bias.
comparison.route_B_direct_human_elicitation: Author Category A via direct human elicitation. Assigns source_group_id = contributor_id or session cleanly, guarantees 100% disjoint train/val/test contributor splitting, and produces contemporary natural Telugu.

bht25_source_group_decision.recommendation: Route B (Direct Human Elicitation) is the safer, cleaner, and higher-fidelity operational route for the custom dataset. BHT25 should be retained strictly as an out-of-domain evaluation benchmark.

statistics_accounting_issue.problem_identified: Schema v1.2.0 language_token_counts requires EN, HI, TE, OTHER, NE, MIXED and sets additionalProperties: false. If a token is annotated as AMBIGUOUS or null, it is silently omitted from language_token_counts, causing total token counts to not equal sentence length.
statistics_accounting_issue.proposed_backward_compatible_correction: In Schema v1.3.0, add AMBIGUOUS and NULL as optional integer properties in language_token_counts while keeping existing keys required, or add metadata.unresolved_token_count. Token count parity sum(counts) == len(tokens) is then preserved.
statistics_accounting_issue.status: Documented and tested; dataset_schema.json kept unchanged in Step 27 per user instructions.

approvals_required_before_collection: Departmental faculty supervisor review and written sign-off on draft_consent_form.md.
Confirmation from institutional research coordinator on whether formal Institutional Review Board (IRB) review is required.
Configuration of secure, encrypted storage for consent archives and pseudonym lookup keys.
Appointment of two independent, qualified reviewers for Stage 1 and Stage 2 verification.
